title: Rewarding Ship Notifications
summary: YTIntel releases now land in Discord like an actual product win: one final @everyone ship notification after the release burst settles, with the release headline, what improved, why it matters, live deployment proof, momentum framing and a direct link back into the product.
discord_changes: Release notifications now send a real @everyone ping instead of a silent embed, so meaningful shipped work is impossible to miss.
Each ship card now shows what changed, why it matters, validation/deployment status, build SHA and direct links to the live app and code diff.
The notification is deliberately rewarding: work shipped, progress banked and release momentum are made visible instead of treating product work like a dry CI receipt.
Burst protection stays intact, so a multi-file release resolves into one polished final notification rather than Discord spam.
changes: Rebuilt the normal YTIntel Discord release message into a premium ship card with a real @everyone mention and explicit allowed_mentions support.
Added a strong release header, creator-intelligence branding, richer coral embed styling and a direct Open YTIntel call to action.
Added WHAT JUST GOT BETTER, WHY THIS MATTERS, RELEASE STATUS, MOMENTUM and BUILD RECEIPT sections so every notification explains both the work and the payoff.
Added live deployment proof covering validation, GitHub Pages deployment, live availability and Discord receipt delivery.
Added build SHA and compare links so every release notification doubles as a lightweight permanent engineering receipt.
Kept the existing 45-second release-burst settle gate and newer-commit suppression so users get one satisfying final ping per release burst.
why_it_matters: Shipping should feel rewarding. If the product improves but the team barely notices, the feedback loop is weak. The new release notification turns completed work into a visible win while still carrying enough evidence to prove that the build actually validated, deployed and went live.
